title: BSU students to study at Kazakh National Women’s Teacher Training University

blocks.text: As part of the academic mobility programme, nine students from Bishkek State University named after Academician K. Karasaev will study at Kazakh National Women’s Teacher Training University in Almaty, Republic of Kazakhstan.

During their studies, the students will be able to deepen their knowledge and gain new academic and professional experience. Participation in the programme helps expand BSU’s international cooperation and educational opportunities for students.
